Topic 1.4: Effective LISTENING

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Effective LISTENING. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. listen with increased attention to 2 lessons stories
2. listen and communicate effectively in varied situations
3. listen to experiences of others and respond appropriately to the feelings and ideas expressed
4. develop an interest in listening to texts on varied themes class.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. listen with increased attention to 2 lessons stories
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to listen with increased attention to 2 lessons stories. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. listen and communicate effectively in varied situations
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to listen and communicate effectively in varied situations. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. listen to experiences of others and respond appropriately to the feelings and ideas expressed
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to listen to experiences of others and respond appropriately to the feelings and ideas expressed. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

4. develop an interest in listening to texts on varied themes class.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to develop an interest in listening to texts on varied themes class. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: When you meet your teacher in the morning, say “Good morning” clearly and smile.

Example 2: Listen to a short story about a child walking to school. Then tell a friend one thing that happened.

Example 3: Write three sentences about your school using new words from this lesson.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Effective LISTENING.
2. Explain Effective LISTENING to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Effective LISTENING.
4. Show that you can: listen with increased attention to 2 lessons stories
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Effective LISTENING. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Effective LISTENING important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. listen with increased attention to 2 lessons stories
2. listen and communicate effectively in varied situations
3. listen to experiences of others and respond appropriately to the feelings and ideas expressed
4. develop an interest in listening to texts on varied themes class.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
